In this video, we uncover the full story of Delhi’s $30 Billion Megacity Plan under the ambitious Delhi Master Plan 2041, which aims to transform India’s capital into a global smart city. Backed by the Smart Cities Mission, PM Gati Shakti Yojana, and massive private investments, this vision will change how Delhi lives, travels, and grows.
This is not just about new roads or flyovers. This is about building a future-ready New Delhi with world-class infrastructure, modern expressways, expanded metro lines, upgraded heritage areas, smart surveillance, green corridors, and more.
